markers.name: Abereri Healing Spring
markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

markers.name: Nautheashe Bridge
markers.note: A stone bridge spans over the Nauthindhella River at Nautheashe. Carts and pack trains cross it from dawn to dusk, bound for the market.

markers.name: House of Dograve
markers.note: A merchant family of Crowdenkeep, one of the richest in the land. Its factors buy and sell across the whole market, and a share of every deal ends in its coffers.

markers.name: House of Fethaldarcrin
markers.note: A merchant family of Mydahas, one of the richest in the land. Its factors buy and sell across the whole market, and a share of every deal ends in its coffers.

markers.note: A fair is being held in Haundhetheas, offering local cheese and vinegar alongside foreign goods and services.

markers.name: Minor Jetty

markers.name: Goats migration

markers.name: Illusory mirage

markers.name: Ubod Sinkhole

zones.name: Smotlian Occupation
zones.note: Troops of Smotlia have crossed into Freysland in the Smotlia-Freyslandian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: Goragh Occupation
zones.note: Troops of Goragh have crossed into T'rirgothr in the Goragh-T'rirgothrian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: Thebish Insurrection
zones.note: Thebel has risen against the rule of Dorethond. Its people are strangers to the ruling culture.

zones.name: Dorethond Rebels
zones.note: People of Wethar along the border with Dorethond have taken up arms against their rulers, backed by their neighbor. Corrupt officials have turned the people against their rulers.

zones.name: Rohandism Proselytism
zones.note: Missionaries of Rohandism preach among the followers of Bozkovana Ethics here, winning converts village by village.

zones.name: Rohandism Proselytism
zones.note: Missionaries of Rohandism preach among the followers of Dark Elfish Ancestors here, winning converts village by village.

zones.name: Smotlesean Crusade
zones.note: Smotlese Schism is condemned as heresy. Crusaders march against its followers wherever they live, burning their shrines.

zones.name: Red Fever
zones.note: An outbreak of red fever that began in the port of Wethar, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: Sivrekan Earthquake
zones.note: An earthquake has struck Sivrek and the land around, toppling houses and blocking roads.

zones.name: Clifrontlean Drought
zones.note: No rain has fallen around Clifrontle for months. Wells run dry and the crops wither in the fields.

zones.name: Manchfield Eruption
zones.note: Manchfield Volcano is erupting. Ash and lava cover the land around it, and people flee its slopes.

zones.name: Mount Bagroc Eruption
zones.note: Mount Bagroc is erupting. Ash and lava cover the land around it, and people flee its slopes.

zones.name: Razogh Avalanche
zones.note: Avalanches have buried the mountain road here. The pass is closed until the snow is cleared.

zones.name: Devan Fault
zones.note: A fault line where the ground cracks and shakes with frequent tremors. Few dare to build here.

zones.name: Stillderdean Flood
zones.note: The Dewfalls river has burst its banks at Stillderde, flooding the streets and the fields along it.

zones.name: Bamberley Tsunami
zones.note: A great wave from the sea has struck this coast, wrecking harbors and drowning the villages along the shore.

zones.name: Smotlian Dearth
zones.note: The poorest countryside of Smotlia. The harvest has failed, and its people have no money to buy grain from the markets, so they go hungry.
